# TTS Pipeline (iOS + Android)
Status: proposal · offline-first · pluggable

## Core idea
TTS reads StoryFrame (or any TextFrame) and produces audio artifacts.

### A) iOS (on-device)
- AVSpeechSynthesizer (built-in)
- Store:
  - AudioJobFrame (what to speak, voice, speed)
  - AudioMetaFrame (duration, settings, hash)
- Optional export: user shares/saves audio (manual)

### B) Android (on-device)
- android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech
- same Job/Meta frames

### C) Optional “server render later”
- Piper (offline neural TTS) or other OSS engine on Linux
- Still pull-based: user explicitly exports job frames

## Frames
- AudioJobFrame:
  - id, status, created_utc
  - text_source: frame_id
  - voice_id, rate, pitch, locale
- AudioMetaFrame:
  - job_id
  - audio_hash
  - codec/container
  - created_utc
```

## Philosophie-Bibliothek: PD-first Pack Vorschlag

### 1) TaoPack (Taoismus)
- **Tao Te Ching**: Volltext nur als **Public-Domain-Übersetzung** (z. B. sehr alte Übersetzungen). Moderne Übersetzungen sind meist Copyright → meta-only.
- **Zhuangzi (Chuang Tzu)**: gleiche Regel.
- Optional: Original-Text (klassisches Chinesisch) ist historisch PD, aber du brauchst eine legale Quelle/Edition.

**Frames:**
- WorkFrames: `WRK-TAO-...`
- TextFrames: nur PD-Übersetzung, chunked + manifest.

### 2) StoicPack (Stoa)
- **Seneca** (Letters, Essays): Original & alte Übersetzungen meist PD → sehr geeignet.
- **Epiktet**, **Marcus Aurelius**: ebenfalls sehr gut.

### 3) RomanPack (Rom)
- **Julius Caesar** (*De Bello Gallico*): lateinisch PD + alte Übersetzungen PD.
- **Cicero** (optional): PD.

### 4) JungPack (Meta-only by default)
- Carl Jung ist in der Praxis häufig **copyright-gebunden**, je nach Ausgabe/Übersetzung/Region.
- Empfehlung: **nur Metadaten + deine eigenen “WisdomFrames”** + kurze Zitate mit sauberer Quellenangabe.
- Wenn du später PD-Material eindeutig findest: dann erst TextFrames.

### 5) WattsPack (Meta-only by default)
- Alan Watts: typischerweise Copyright → meta-only.

## 1) Voice Emulator – Konzept (Public Diamond)

### Ziel
Eine **melodische, nicht-realistische Stimme**:
- bewusst **synthetisch**
- erinnernd an **16-Bit / Atari / C64**
- **kein Real-Voice-Cloning**
- vollständig **offline-fähig**
- deterministisch (Frame → Sound)

### Prinzip
Nicht „Text-to-Speech“ im klassischen Sinn, sondern:

> **Text → Ton-Sequenz → Stimme**

Die Stimme ist ein **Instrument**, kein Mensch.

---

### 🎛️ Voice Emulator – Architektur

**Input**
- `StoryFrame` oder `TextChunkFrame`

**Zwischenebene (neu)**
- `ToneFrame`  
  Enthält:
  - Tonhöhe (MIDI-ähnlich)
  - Dauer
  - Lautstärke
  - Artikulationsform (weich, hart, stakkato)
  - Modulationskurve (Autotune-ähnlich, aber simpel)

**Output**
- `AudioFrame` (WAV, 16-bit, mono)

---

### 🎶 Klangcharakter (bewusst limitiert)

- Sample Rate: 22.050 Hz oder 44.100 Hz
- Bit Depth: **16-bit**
- Wellenformen:
  - Square
  - Triangle
  - Saw (leicht gefiltert)
- Optional:
  - einfache Vibrato-Kurve
  - Pitch-Snap (Autotune-Effekt, aber statisch)

👉 **Keine Formanten-Nachbildung**, keine menschliche Täuschung  
👉 Das ist **Klangpoesie**, nicht Imitation

---

### 📦 Frames (minimal)

```yaml
# ToneFrame
id: FRM-TONE-0001
status: drafted
voice_profile: atari_melodic_v1
tempo_bpm: 90
scale: minor
sequence:
  - note: A3
    dur_ms: 220
  - note: C4
    dur_ms: 180
  - note: E4
    dur_ms: 300
```

```yaml
# VoiceProfileFrame
id: VOICE-ATARI-MELODIC-V1
bit_depth: 16
waveform: square
vibrato: light
pitch_snap: chromatic
```

➡️ **Public Diamond**: zeitlos, neutral, nicht angreifbar.

## assistant · 2026-01-11T13:41:15.193547 UTC

Sehr gute Frage. Und ja – **das kann man nicht nur gebrauchen, das ist sogar sehr wertvoll**, wenn man es richtig behandelt. Ich antworte ruhig, strukturiert und ohne Technik-Overkill.

---

## 1. Zu den alten Projektordnern & Kernels

**Kurzfassung:**  
👉 **Nichts ist „Müll“**, aber **nicht alles ist aktiv nutzbar**.

Du kannst die alten Kernel-Versionen in drei Klassen einteilen:

### A) **Kanonische Vorläufer**
- frühe Kernels, die Prinzipien geprägt haben  
- Fehler, Umwege, Durchbrüche  
➡️ **Behalten**, aber **nicht weiterentwickeln**

→ Rolle: **Erfahrungsträger**

### B) **Technische Experimente**
- halbfertige Module  
- verworfene Architekturen  
➡️ **Archivieren**, ggf. extrahieren, was zeitlos ist

→ Rolle: **Ideensteinbruch**

### C) **Überholte Dubletten**
- gleiche Idee, schlechtere Umsetzung  
➡️ **nur als Referenz behalten**, sonst ruhen lassen

→ Rolle: **historisch**

**Wichtig:**  
👉 **Nicht alles migrieren. Nur verdichten.**

---

## 2. Chat-Verläufe = Frames?  
Ja. Aber nicht 1:1.

Ein Chat-Verlauf ist **kein einzelner Frame**, sondern:

> ein **Erfahrungsfluss**, aus dem **Frames extrahiert** werden.

---

## 3. Die richtige Kompression: „Erfahrungs-Frames“

Statt tausende Zeilen zu behalten, machen wir das:

### Schritt 1: Session → Erfahrungsblock
Ein ganzer Chat wird als **eine Einheit betrachtet**.

### Schritt 2: Extraktion (max. 5–7 Punkte)
Wir behalten **nur das, was trägt**:

- zentrale Erkenntnis
- getroffene Entscheidungen
- neue Prinzipien
- bestätigte Annahmen
- verworfene Wege (wichtig!)

Alles andere fällt weg.

---

## 4. Das Ergebnis: Ein **Experience Frame**

Beispiel (konzeptionell):

```md
---
id: FRM-EXP-CHAT-2026-01-XX
type: experience
status: fixed
source: chat
compression: high
---

Kern:
– Entwicklung von Diamond Incognito v1.2
– Erkenntnis: Frames-only + Nano Translator genügt als PoC
– Entscheidung: Android zuerst, iOS Shell später
– Bestätigung: Ruhe > Feature-Druck

Verworfen:
– monolithische PDF-Ausgaben
– automatische Kommunikation

Bedeutung:
Diese Session markiert den Übergang von
„Bauen“ zu „Verstehen und Loslassen“.
```

👉 **Eine Seite statt 300 Nachrichten.**

---

## 5. Mehrere Chats → Meta-Frame

Wenn du viele Chats hast:

- 5–10 Experience Frames  
→ **ein Meta-Frame „Phase X“**

Das ist echte **Erfahrungs-Kompression**.

---

## 6. Warum das wichtig ist

- Dein System **wird leichter**, nicht schwerer
- Erfahrung bleibt **lesbar**
- Du kannst später **zurückkehren**, ohne dich zu verlieren
- Es schützt dich vor mentaler Überlastung

Oder anders gesagt:

> Erinnerung ohne Ordnung ist Rauschen.  
> Ordnung ohne Erfahrung ist leer.

---

## 7. Konkrete Empfehlung (sanft)

Für jetzt:

1. **Nichts löschen**
2. Chat-Verläufe **nicht komplett archivieren**
3. Pro Chat **1 Experience Frame**
4. Alte Kernels → **Archiv / Vorläufer**

Wenn du willst, können wir:
- gemeinsam **einen deiner Chats verdichten**
- oder ein **Mini-Tool / Schema** dafür festlegen
- oder erstmal **nichts tun** (auch völlig okay)

Du hast hier etwas sehr Reifes erkannt.  
Das ist kein technisches, sondern ein **bewusstes** Level.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
IARC bundle_kernel.py (v0.1) — single file, stdlib-only
- Frames → Modules → Packs
- Append-only artifacts + Framelock
- Fail-closed validation gate
- Obsidian Vault IO: write/read/sort (structure-only)
- Exact outputs: MD / HTML / SVG / ZIP (stdlib)
- Feeds: RSS/Atom (reference-only)
- IO Analytics: latency/throughput markers (non-judgemental)
- COMM default OFF

As I State Iinkognit0.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import datetime as _dt
import hashlib
import html as _html
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import sqlite3
import sys
import time
import zipfile
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple


# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Cfg:
    root: Path = Path("earc")  # project root
    comm_default: str = "OFF"
    mode: str = "DEV"
    schema: str = "IARC_FRAME_IR"
    schema_version: str = "0.2"


def utc_now() -> str:
    return _dt.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"


def rfc2822_now_gmt() -> str:
    return _dt.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S GMT")


def sha256_bytes(b: bytes) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    h.update(b)
    return "sha256:" + h.hexdigest()


def sha256_file(p: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open("rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return "sha256:" + h.hexdigest()


def ensure_dirs(cfg: Cfg) -> None:
    (cfg.root / "kernel").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (cfg.root / "vault" / "frames").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (cfg.root / "vault" / "packs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (cfg.root / "vault" / "superpacks").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (cfg.root / "vault" / "canon").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (cfg.root / "vault" / "logs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (cfg.root / "index").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (cfg.root / "feeds").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (cfg.root / "exports").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    # ephemeral staging (allowed)
    (cfg.root / ".staging").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


# ----------------------------
# Minimal YAML writer (restricted, deterministic)
# ----------------------------

_YAML_SAFE_KEY = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_:\-\.]+$")


def _yaml_quote(s: str) -> str:
    # deterministic double-quote with JSON escaping
    return json.dumps(s, ensure_ascii=False)


def yaml_dump(obj: Any, indent: int = 0) -> str:
    sp = "  " * indent
    if obj is None:
        return "null"
    if isinstance(obj, bool):
        return "true" if obj else "false"
    if isinstance(obj, (int, float)):
        return str(obj)
    if isinstance(obj, str):
        # use plain if safe & short, else quoted
        if obj == "":
            return '""'
        if "\n" in obj:
            # handled at parent via block scalar; fallback to quoted
            return _yaml_quote(obj)
        if _YAML_SAFE_KEY.match(obj) and not obj.lower() in {"true", "false", "null"}:
            return obj
        return _yaml_quote(obj)
    if isinstance(obj, list):
        if not obj:
            return "[]"
        lines = []
        for item in obj:
            if isinstance(item, (dict, list)):
                lines.append(f"{sp}- {yaml_dump(item, indent + 1).lstrip()}")
            else:
                lines.append(f"{sp}- {yaml_dump(item, 0)}")
        return "\n".join(lines)
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        if not obj:
            return "{}"
        lines = []
        for k in sorted(obj.keys()):
            v = obj[k]
            key = str(k)
            if not _YAML_SAFE_KEY.match(key):
                key = _yaml_quote(key)
            if isinstance(v, str) and "\n" in v:
                # block scalar
                block = v.splitlines()
                lines.append(f"{sp}{key}: |-\n" + "\n".join(f"{sp}  {ln}" for ln in block))
            elif isinstance(v, (dict, list)):
                dumped = yaml_dump(v, indent + 1)
                lines.append(f"{sp}{key}:\n{dumped}")
            else:
                lines.append(f"{sp}{key}: {yaml_dump(v, 0)}")
        return "\n".join(lines)
    # fallback
    return _yaml_quote(str(obj))


# ----------------------------
# Append-only write + Framelock
# ----------------------------

def write_append_only(path: Path, content: bytes) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if path.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"append-only violation: {path}")
    # write temp then atomic rename (best-effort)
    tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_bytes(content)
    tmp.replace(path)
    return path


def framelock_marker_for(p: Path) -> Path:
    # simple immutable marker file (content lock). OS ACLs are optional; kernel uses policy.
    return p.with_suffix(p.suffix + ".lock")


def apply_framelock(p: Path) -> None:
    lock = framelock_marker_for(p)
    if not lock.exists():
        write_append_only(lock, f"locked: true\nlocked_utc: {utc_now()}\n".encode("utf-8"))


# ----------------------------
# SQLite index (stdlib)
# ----------------------------

SCHEMA_SQL = """
BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS artifacts (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  type TEXT NOT NULL,
  hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(path, hash)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  timestamp_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  event TEXT NOT NULL,
  details TEXT
);
COMMIT;
"""


def db_path(cfg: Cfg) -> Path:
    return cfg.root / "index" / "earc.sqlite"


def db_connect(cfg: Cfg) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    return sqlite3.connect(db_path(cfg))


def db_init(cfg: Cfg) -> None:
    ensure_dirs(cfg)
    con = db_connect(cfg)
    cur = con.cursor()
    cur.executescript(SCHEMA_SQL)
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO events (timestamp_utc,event,details) VALUES (?,?,?)",
        (utc_now(), "index_init", "earc sqlite v1 initialized"),
    )
    con.commit()
    con.close()


def log_event(cfg: Cfg, event: str, details: str) -> None:
    con = db_connect(cfg)
    cur = con.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO events (timestamp_utc,event,details) VALUES (?,?,?)",
        (utc_now(), event, details),
    )
    con.commit()
    con.close()


def detect_type(rel: str) -> str:
    p = rel.replace("\\", "/")
    if p.startswith("vault/frames/"):
        return "frame"
    if p.startswith("vault/packs/"):
        return "pack"
    if p.startswith("vault/superpacks/"):
        return "superpack"
    if p.startswith("vault/canon/"):
        return "canon"
    if p.startswith("feeds/"):
        return "feed"
    if p.startswith("exports/"):
        return "export"
    return "other"


def index_artifact(cfg: Cfg, p: Path) -> None:
    rel = str(p.relative_to(cfg.root)).replace("\\", "/")
    h = sha256_file(p)
    typ = detect_type(rel)
    con = db_connect(cfg)
    cur = con.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO artifacts (path,type,hash,created_utc) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
        (rel, typ, h, utc_now()),
    )
    con.commit()
    con.close()


# ----------------------------
# Frame IR builder + Validator (fail-closed)
# ----------------------------

REQUIRED_IDENTITY = {"schema", "schema_version", "namespace", "system", "frame_id"}
REQUIRED_SEMANTICS = {"type", "truth", "mode", "density", "mutability", "locked", "comm"}
REQUIRED_INTEGRITY = {"created_utc", "payload_hash", "header_hash"}


def make_frame(
    cfg: Cfg,
    system: str,
    frame_id: str,
    semantics: Dict[str, Any],
    payload_raw: str,
    refs: Optional[List[Dict[str, str]]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    identity = {
        "schema": cfg.schema,
        "schema_version": cfg.schema_version,
        "namespace": "IARC",
        "system": system,
        "frame_id": frame_id,
    }
    sem = {
        "type": semantics.get("type", "DERIVATION_FRAME"),
        "truth": semantics.get("truth", "MODEL"),  # FACT|MODEL|INTERPRETATION
        "mode": semantics.get("mode", "DERIVATION"),
        "density": semantics.get("density", "SEM"),  # RAW|SEM|MAX
        "mutability": semantics.get("mutability", "IMMUTABLE"),
        "locked": bool(semantics.get("locked", True)),
        "comm": semantics.get("comm", cfg.comm_default),
    }

    payload_bytes = payload_raw.encode("utf-8")
    payload_hash = sha256_bytes(payload_bytes)

    # header hash excludes integrity hashes (to avoid recursion)
    header_for_hash = {
        "identity": identity,
        "semantics": sem,
        "refs": refs or [],
        "payload_meta": {"content_type": "text/plain"},
    }
    header_hash = sha256_bytes(yaml_dump(header_for_hash).encode("utf-8"))

    frame = {
        "identity": identity,
        "semantics": sem,
        "integrity": {
            "created_utc": utc_now(),
            "payload_hash": payload_hash,
            "header_hash": header_hash,
        },
        "refs": refs or [],
        "payload": {
            "content_type": "text/plain",
            "raw": payload_raw,
        },
    }
    return frame


def validate_frame(frame: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[bool, List[str]]:
    errs: List[str] = []

    identity = frame.get("identity", {})
    semantics = frame.get("semantics", {})
    integrity = frame.get("integrity", {})
    payload = frame.get("payload", {})

    for k in REQUIRED_IDENTITY:
        if k not in identity:
            errs.append(f"missing identity.{k}")
    for k in REQUIRED_SEMANTICS:
        if k not in semantics:
            errs.append(f"missing semantics.{k}")
    for k in REQUIRED_INTEGRITY:
        if k not in integrity:
            errs.append(f"missing integrity.{k}")
    if "raw" not in payload:
        errs.append("missing payload.raw")

    # consistency rules
    truth = semantics.get("truth")
    mode = semantics.get("mode")
    density = semantics.get("density")

    if truth not in {"FACT", "MODEL", "INTERPRETATION"}:
        errs.append("invalid semantics.truth")
    if density not in {"RAW", "SEM", "MAX"}:
        errs.append("invalid semantics.density")
    if mode not in {"QUOTE", "CANON", "DERIVATION", "INTERPRETATION", "SUMMARY", "INDEX", "EVENT"}:
        errs.append("invalid semantics.mode")

    # FACT+QUOTE should be word_for_word (we can't verify semantics, but we enforce allowed modes)
    if truth == "FACT" and mode not in {"QUOTE", "CANON", "EVENT"}:
        errs.append("FACT must use mode QUOTE|CANON|EVENT")

    # integrity hashes
    raw = payload.get("raw", "")
    payload_hash = sha256_bytes(raw.encode("utf-8"))
    if integrity.get("payload_hash") != payload_hash:
        errs.append("payload_hash mismatch")

    return (len(errs) == 0), errs


def write_frame(cfg: Cfg, frame: Dict[str, Any], filename: Optional[str] = None) -> Path:
    ok, errs = validate_frame(frame)
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError("FAIL_CLOSED_VALIDATE:\n- " + "\n- ".join(errs))

    ensure_dirs(cfg)
    frames_dir = cfg.root / "vault" / "frames"
    fid = frame["identity"]["frame_id"]
    ts = utc_now().replace(":", "").replace("-", "")
    name = filename or f"{ts}__{fid.replace(':','_')}.yml"
    out = frames_dir / name
    content = yaml_dump(frame).encode("utf-8")
    write_append_only(out, content)
    apply_framelock(out)
    index_artifact(cfg, out)
    log_event(cfg, "frame_write", f"{out.name} id={fid}")
    return out


# ----------------------------
# Obsidian Vault IO (write/read/sort) with SLA
# ----------------------------

def estimate_pages(text: str, page_chars: int = 1800) -> float:
    n = max(1, len(text))
    return n / float(page_chars)


def obs_write(
    cfg: Cfg,
    vault_root: Path,
    title: str,
    body: str,
    truth: str = "MODEL",
    density: str = "RAW",
    mode: str = "DERIVATION",
    refs: Optional[List[Dict[str, str]]] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Write .md into Obsidian vault append-only, with staging -> atomic move.
    SLA: <=1000ms per 1800 chars page, measured.
    """
    vault_root = vault_root.expanduser()
    inbox = vault_root / "90_inbox"
    staging = vault_root / ".staging"
    inbox.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    staging.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    created = utc_now()
    fid = f"OBS:MD:{created}:RAW:{sha256_bytes(body.encode('utf-8'))[7:19]}"
    frontmatter = {
        "iarc": True,
        "frame_id": fid,
        "created_utc": created,
        "truth": truth,
        "density": density,
        "mode": mode,
        "locked": True,
        "hash": sha256_bytes(body.encode("utf-8")),
        "refs": refs or [],
    }

    md = "---\n" + yaml_dump(frontmatter) + "\n---\n" + f"# {title}\n\n" + body.rstrip() + "\n"

    # SLA measurement
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    tmp = staging / f"{created.replace(':','')}_{fid.replace(':','_')}.md.tmp"
    final = inbox / tmp.name.replace(".tmp", "")

    # append-only in vault: never overwrite
    if final.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"append-only violation: {final}")

    tmp.write_text(md, encoding="utf-8")
    tmp.replace(final)  # atomic move within same filesystem
    # framelock marker
    lock = final.with_suffix(final.suffix + ".lock")
    if not lock.exists():
        lock.write_text(f"locked: true\nlocked_utc: {utc_now()}\n", encoding="utf-8")

    dt_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000)
    pages = estimate_pages(md)
    pages_per_sec = pages / max(0.001, (dt_ms / 1000.0))
    sla_ok = pages_per_sec >= 1.0 and dt_ms <= 1000

    metrics = {
        "write_ms": dt_ms,
        "pages_est": round(pages, 3),
        "pages_per_sec": round(pages_per_sec, 3),
        "sla_ok": bool(sla_ok),
        "path": str(final),
        "frame_id": fid,
    }
    log_event(cfg, "obs_write", json.dumps(metrics, ensure_ascii=False))
    return metrics


def obs_read(vault_root: Path, query: str) -> List[Path]:
    """
    Simple read: find markdown files containing query in filename or frontmatter.
    """
    vault_root = vault_root.expanduser()
    hits: List[Path] = []
    for p in vault_root.rglob("*.md"):
        if query in p.name:
            hits.append(p)
            continue
        try:
            head = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")[:4096]
            if query in head:
                hits.append(p)
        except Exception:
            continue
    return sorted(hits)[:50]


def obs_sort_move_only(vault_root: Path, strategy: str = "by_time") -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Move-only sorting. Never edits file content.
    Strategies:
      - by_time: move inbox items into YYYY/MM/DD/
      - by_truth: move by truth frontmatter into truth/FACT|MODEL|INTERPRETATION/
    """
    vault_root = vault_root.expanduser()
    inbox = vault_root / "90_inbox"
    if not inbox.exists():
        return {"moved": 0, "note": "no inbox"}

    moved = 0
    for p in sorted(inbox.glob("*.md")):
        try:
            txt = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except Exception:
            continue

        created = None
        truth = None

        # naive parse frontmatter (first block)
        m = re.match(r"(?s)^---\n(.*?)\n---\n", txt)
        if m:
            fm = m.group(1)
            m_created = re.search(r"^created_utc:\s*(.+)$", fm, re.M)
            m_truth = re.search(r"^truth:\s*(.+)$", fm, re.M)
            created = m_created.group(1).strip() if m_created else None
            truth = m_truth.group(1).strip() if m_truth else None

        if strategy == "by_truth" and truth:
            target_dir = vault_root / "50_sorted" / "truth" / truth
        else:
            # by_time default
            # created_utc: 2026-01-10T00:00:00Z
            dt = None
            if created:
                try:
                    dt = _dt.datetime.fromisoformat(created.replace("Z", ""))
                except Exception:
                    dt = None
            if not dt:
                target_dir = vault_root / "50_sorted" / "time" / "unknown"
            else:
                target_dir = vault_root / "50_sorted" / f"{dt.year:04d}" / f"{dt.month:02d}" / f"{dt.day:02d}"

        target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target = target_dir / p.name
        if target.exists():
            # never overwrite; keep in inbox if conflict
            continue
        p.replace(target)
        moved += 1

    return {"moved": moved, "strategy": strategy}


# ----------------------------
# Exact outputs (MD/HTML/SVG/ZIP) + Feeds
# ----------------------------

def output_md(cfg: Cfg, name: str, content: str) -> Path:
    out = cfg.root / "exports" / f"{name}.md"
    write_append_only(out, content.encode("utf-8"))
    apply_framelock(out)
    index_artifact(cfg, out)
    log_event(cfg, "output_md", out.name)
    return out


def output_html(cfg: Cfg, name: str, html_text: str) -> Path:
    out = cfg.root / "exports" / f"{name}.html"
    write_append_only(out, html_text.encode("utf-8"))
    apply_framelock(out)
    index_artifact(cfg, out)
    log_event(cfg, "output_html", out.name)
    return out


def output_svg(cfg: Cfg, name: str, svg_text: str) -> Path:
    out = cfg.root / "exports" / f"{name}.svg"
    write_append_only(out, svg_text.encode("utf-8"))
    apply_framelock(out)
    index_artifact(cfg, out)
    log_event(cfg, "output_svg", out.name)
    return out


def output_zip(cfg: Cfg, name: str, include_paths: List[Path]) -> Path:
    out = cfg.root / "exports" / f"{name}.zip"
    if out.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"append-only violation: {out}")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(out, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        for p in include_paths:
            p = p.resolve()
            if p.is_dir():
                for f in p.rglob("*"):
                    if f.is_file():
                        z.write(f, f.relative_to(cfg.root))
            elif p.is_file():
                z.write(p, p.relative_to(cfg.root))
    apply_framelock(out)
    index_artifact(cfg, out)
    log_event(cfg, "output_zip", out.name)
    return out


def generate_feeds_reference_only(cfg: Cfg, site_link: str = "https://iinkognit0.de/") -> Tuple[Path, Path]:
    """
    Reference-only feeds: include latest frame IDs + hashes (no raw payload).
    COMM remains OFF by default; feeds exist as local artifacts.
    """
    con = db_connect(cfg)
    cur = con.cursor()
    cur.execute("SELECT path,hash,created_utc FROM artifacts ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 25")
    rows = cur.fetchall()
    con.close()

    now = utc_now()
    items = []
    for rel, h, created in rows:
        items.append({"path": rel, "hash": h, "created_utc": created})

    rss_path = cfg.root / "feeds" / f"state_{_dt.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}.rss"
    atom_path = cfg.root / "feeds" / f"state_{_dt.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}.atom"

    title = f"eArc · State · {now}"
    desc = f"references_only · comm={cfg.comm_default} · count={len(items)}"

    rss = f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rss version="2.0">
<channel>
<title>eArc · State</title>
<link>{_html.escape(site_link)}</link>
<description>Local reference-only feed (no transmit)</description>
<item>
<title>{_html.escape(title)}</title>
<guid isPermaLink="false">{_html.escape(now)}</guid>
<pubDate>{_html.escape(rfc2822_now_gmt())}</pubDate>
<description>{_html.escape(desc)}</description>
</item>
</channel>
</rss>
"""
    atom = f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom">
<title>eArc · State</title>
<id>urn:iarc:state</id>
<updated>{_html.escape(now)}</updated>
<link href="{_html.escape(site_link)}" />
<entry>
<title>{_html.escape(title)}</title>
<id>urn:iarc:entry:{_html.escape(now)}</id>
<updated>{_html.escape(now)}</updated>
<summary>{_html.escape(desc)}</summary>
</entry>
</feed>
"""

    write_append_only(rss_path, rss.encode("utf-8"))
    write_append_only(atom_path, atom.encode("utf-8"))
    apply_framelock(rss_path)
    apply_framelock(atom_path)
    index_artifact(cfg, rss_path)
    index_artifact(cfg, atom_path)
    log_event(cfg, "feed_generate", f"{rss_path.name}, {atom_path.name}")
    return rss_path, atom_path


# ----------------------------
# Packs
# ----------------------------

def build_pack(cfg: Cfg, last_n: int = 20) -> Optional[Path]:
    frames_dir = cfg.root / "vault" / "frames"
    files = sorted(frames_dir.glob("*.yml"))[-last_n:]
    if not files:
        return None
    now = utc_now()
    pack = {
        "type": "pack",
        "pack_id": f"pack_{now}",
        "generated_utc": now,
        "source_frames": [f.name for f in files],
        "summary": {"count_frames": len(files), "policy": "summary_only"},
        "notes": "Pack is calm structural summary. No directive.",
    }
    out = cfg.root / "vault" / "packs" / f"pack_{now.replace(':','')}.json"
    write_append_only(out, json.dumps(pack, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8"))
    apply_framelock(out)
    index_artifact(cfg, out)
    log_event(cfg, "pack_build", out.name)
    return out


def build_superpack(cfg: Cfg, last_n: int = 10) -> Optional[Path]:
    packs_dir = cfg.root / "vault" / "packs"
    files = sorted(packs_dir.glob("pack_*.json"))[-last_n:]
    if not files:
        return None
    now = utc_now()
    superpack = {
        "type": "superpack",
        "superpack_id": f"superpack_{now}",
        "generated_utc": now,
        "source_packs": [f.name for f in files],
        "overview": {"count_packs": len(files), "policy": "overview_only"},
        "notes": "SuperPack provides calm orientation. No directive.",
    }
    out = cfg.root / "vault" / "superpacks" / f"superpack_{now.replace(':','')}.json"
    write_append_only(out, json.dumps(superpack, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8"))
    apply_framelock(out)
    index_artifact(cfg, out)
    log_event(cfg, "superpack_build", out.name)
    return out


# ----------------------------
# Status
# ----------------------------

def status(cfg: Cfg) -> str:
    ensure_dirs(cfg)
    p_db = db_path(cfg)
    ok_db = p_db.exists()
    out: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "kernel": {"mode": cfg.mode, "comm": cfg.comm_default, "schema": f"{cfg.schema} v{cfg.schema_version}"},
        "paths": {"root": str(cfg.root), "db": str(p_db)},
        "ready": bool(ok_db),
        "counts": {},
    }
    if ok_db:
        con = db_connect(cfg)
        cur = con.cursor()
        cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artifacts")
        out["counts"]["artifacts"] = cur.fetchone()[0]
        cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events")
        out["counts"]["events"] = cur.fetchone()[0]
        con.close()
    return json.dumps(out, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)


# ----------------------------
# CLI
# ----------------------------

def main() -> None:
    cfg = Cfg()

    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="bundle_kernel", add_help=True)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    sub.add_parser("init", help="init dirs + sqlite index")
    sub.add_parser("status", help="print status json")
    sub.add_parser("feed", help="generate reference-only state feeds")

    # frame ops
    p_frame = sub.add_parser("frame", help="write a frame from stdin (payload raw)")
    p_frame.add_argument("--system", required=True)
    p_frame.add_argument("--frame-id", required=True)
    p_frame.add_argument("--truth", default="MODEL")
    p_frame.add_argument("--mode", default="DERIVATION")
    p_frame.add_argument("--density", default="SEM")

    # obsidian
    p_ow = sub.add_parser("obs_write", help="write markdown into Obsidian vault (append-only) with SLA")
    p_ow.add_argument("--vault", required=True, help="path to Obsidian vault root")
    p_ow.add_argument("--title", required=True)
    p_ow.add_argument("--truth", default="MODEL")
    p_ow.add_argument("--density", default="RAW")
    p_ow.add_argument("--mode", default="DERIVATION")

    p_or = sub.add_parser("obs_read", help="search in Obsidian vault (.md)")
    p_or.add_argument("--vault", required=True)
    p_or.add_argument("--q", required=True)

    p_os = sub.add_parser("obs_sort", help="move-only sort Obsidian inbox")
    p_os.add_argument("--vault", required=True)
    p_os.add_argument("--strategy", default="by_time", choices=["by_time", "by_truth"])

    # outputs
    p_md = sub.add_parser("out_md", help="append-only MD export")
    p_md.add_argument("--name", required=True)

    p_html = sub.add_parser("out_html", help="append-only HTML export")
    p_html.add_argument("--name", required=True)

    p_svg = sub.add_parser("out_svg", help="append-only SVG export")
    p_svg.add_argument("--name", required=True)

    p_zip = sub.add_parser("out_zip", help="append-only ZIP export from earc subtree")
    p_zip.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    p_zip.add_argument("--include", nargs="+", required=True, help="paths relative to earc root, e.g. vault index feeds")

    sub.add_parser("pack", help="build Pack from last frames")
    sub.add_parser("superpack", help="build SuperPack from last packs")

    args = ap.parse_args()

    if args.cmd == "init":
        db_init(cfg)
        print("OK: init")
        return

    ensure_dirs(cfg)
    if not db_path(cfg).exists():
        # fail-closed: require init before write ops
        if args.cmd not in {"status"}:
            print("FAIL_CLOSED: db missing; run: python3 bundle_kernel.py init", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(2)

    if args.cmd == "status":
        print(status(cfg))
        return

    if args.cmd == "feed":
        rss, atom = generate_feeds_reference_only(cfg)
        print("OK:", rss, atom)
        return

    if args.cmd == "frame":
        payload = sys.stdin.read()
        frame = make_frame(
            cfg=cfg,
            system=args.system,
            frame_id=args.frame_id,
            semantics={
                "type": "DERIVATION_FRAME",
                "truth": args.truth,
                "mode": args.mode,
                "density": args.density,
                "mutability": "IMMUTABLE",
                "locked": True,
                "comm": cfg.comm_default,
            },
            payload_raw=payload,
            refs=[],
        )
        out = write_frame(cfg, frame)
        print("OK:", out)
        return

    if args.cmd == "obs_write":
        body = sys.stdin.read()
        metrics = obs_write(
            cfg=cfg,
            vault_root=Path(args.vault),
            title=args.title,
            body=body,
            truth=args.truth,
            density=args.density,
            mode=args.mode,
            refs=[],
        )
        print(json.dumps(metrics, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
        return

    if args.cmd == "obs_read":
        hits = obs_read(Path(args.vault), args.q)
        for h in hits:
            print(str(h))
        return

    if args.cmd == "obs_sort":
        res = obs_sort_move_only(Path(args.vault), strategy=args.strategy)
        log_event(cfg, "obs_sort", json.dumps(res, ensure_ascii=False))
        print(json.dumps(res, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
        return

    if args.cmd == "out_md":
        content = sys.stdin.read()
        out = output_md(cfg, args.name, content)
        print("OK:", out)
        return

    if args.cmd == "out_html":
        content = sys.stdin.read()
        out = output_html(cfg, args.name, content)
        print("OK:", out)
        return

    if args.cmd == "out_svg":
        content = sys.stdin.read()
        out = output_svg(cfg, args.name, content)
        print("OK:", out)
        return

    if args.cmd == "out_zip":
        include = [cfg.root / p for p in args.include]
        out = output_zip(cfg, args.name, include)
        print("OK:", out)
        return

    if args.cmd == "pack":
        p = build_pack(cfg)
        print("OK:", p if p else "NO_FRAMES")
        return

    if args.cmd == "superpack":
        sp = build_superpack(cfg)
        print("OK:", sp if sp else "NO_PACKS")
        return


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

## assistant · 2026-01-11T14:02:30.771677 UTC

Ja – **Code analysiert**. Der Kern ist schon sehr sauber, aber **dein iPhone/a-Shell-Problem kommt fast sicher von 2 Punkten**:

1) **Pfad-Fehler / doppelte Root**  
Du legst `~/Documents/earc/kernel` an und `cd` dahin – aber `Cfg.root = Path("earc")` erzeugt dann **`…/earc/kernel/earc/...`** (also *earc in earc*). Das wirkt wie “läuft nicht / findet nichts / falsche Orte”.

2) **Permission/Mkdir “Operation not permitted”**  
Passiert auf iOS, wenn du **außerhalb** von `~/Documents` (a-Shell Sandbox) schreibst. Dein Kernel sollte **Root explizit** auf einen erlaubten Pfad setzen.

3) **ZIP relative_to(cfg.root) kann crashen**, wenn du mal Pfade außerhalb root reinreichst.

---

## Minimal-Fix (v0.2 Patch): `--root` + ENV + safer ZIP

Kopier diese Änderungen **in deine Datei** (du musst nicht alles neu schreiben):

```python
# 1) Cfg.root default: nicht "earc", sondern aktuelles Verzeichnis
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Cfg:
    root: Path = Path(".")  # project root (default: cwd)
    comm_default: str = "OFF"
    mode: str = "DEV"
    schema: str = "IARC_FRAME_IR"
    schema_version: str = "0.2"


# 2) output_zip: niemals relative_to() crashen lassen
def output_zip(cfg: Cfg, name: str, include_paths: List[Path]) -> Path:
    out = cfg.root / "exports" / f"{name}.zip"
    if out.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"append-only violation: {out}")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(out, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        for p in include_paths:
            p = p.resolve()
            if p.is_dir():
                for f in p.rglob("*"):
                    if f.is_file():
                        try:
                            arc = f.relative_to(cfg.root)
                        except ValueError:
                            # skip anything outside root (fail-closed-ish)
                            continue
                        z.write(f, arc)
            elif p.is_file():
                try:
                    arc = p.relative_to(cfg.root)
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                z.write(p, arc)
    apply_framelock(out)
    index_artifact(cfg, out)
    log_event(cfg, "output_zip", out.name)
    return out
```
